title: Maria Goeppert Mayer's birth chart
metaDescription: Maria Goeppert Mayer's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 5.8° Cancer. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the ten placements whose signs are settled stand in Cancer — the Sun, Mercury, Mars and Neptune. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's position resolves to 5.8° Cancer — deep enough in the first decan (0°–10°) that the Moon, its traditional sub-ruler, colours the reading.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 26.0° Cancer; Venus stands at 9.2° Leo; Mars stands at 11.0° Cancer. The tradition reads thought steeped in tone and memory from Mercury, attraction declared rather than implied from Venus, effort that surges when it matters from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Closest first: Jupiter to Pluto, a conjunction with 0.3° of slack. A conjunction concentrates rather than balances — the pair burns one fuel line. Behind it, the Sun opposition Uranus at 0.7°, and Mars conjunction Neptune at 1.1° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: Mercury makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Read against the old dignities, two placements stand out. Mars in Cancer at 11.0° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Jupiter in Gemini at 22.9° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain. None of this ranks anyone; dignity describes footing, and footing can be worked with.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Balance, counted honestly across the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: elements water 5, earth 2, air 2, fire 1; modalities cardinal 5, mutable 4, fixed 1. Saturn and Uranus were retrograde — motion that reverses only from this vantage point, and which the old reading treats as delay used for revision.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Virgo for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 13.4° between midnight and midnight. The missing clock moves the Moon by half a sign at most here, and the boundary was never close. At the noon reference it stands at 21.2°.
